questions.message: A full-time employee with less than 3 years’ service receives 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays.[1]
Report by 09:30 on the first day of absence. Shift and on-call workers must report at least 1 hour before their shift or rota period starts. [1][2]
Submit your expense claim within 30 calendar days of the date the expense was incurred. [1][2]
The Standard is owned by the Head of Workplace Experience. [1]
The Leave and Absence Standard, version 1.2, is currently in force; it took effect on 1 October 2026 and superseded Leave Policy v1.0. [1]
Probation is 6 months from the employee’s start date. It can be extended once by up to 3 months, with written confirmation before the original probation end date. [1]
Standard hours are 37.5 hours a week, 7.5 hours a day, plus an unpaid 60-minute lunch. Core hours are 10:00 to 16:00, within a flexible working band of 07:30 to 19:00. [1]
Salary is paid on the 25th of each month. If it falls on a weekend or bank holiday, it is paid on the previous working day. [1]

Report it to the IT Service Desk immediately, and no later than 1 hour after discovering it. [1][2] If it was stolen, report the theft to police within 24 hours and add the crime reference number to your IT ticket. [1]
Passwords must be at least 14 characters long. [1] MFA is mandatory for all Northstar systems. [1]
An employee can make up to 2 statutory flexible-working requests in any 12-month period. [1][2]
The annual learning budget is £1,000 per employee per financial year (1 April to 31 March). [1]
The 2026 company shutdown is Tuesday 29 through Thursday 31 December. [1][2]
What exact date in November will you start? Your first-year allowance is prorated.
Call your line manager by 09:30 on your first day off sick. [1][2] If you work shifts or are on call, call at least 1 hour before your shift or rota period starts. [1][2]

Yes. You can normally carry over up to 5 days of unused holiday, and must use them by 31 March of the next leave year. [1]

Exceptions may allow more: sickness absence can qualify for up to 4 additional weeks; family-related leave can allow all untaken leave for the year; and exceptional business reasons can allow 5 extra days with approval and a request by 30 November. [1]
No. For three calendar days off sick, self-certification is enough; complete the form in PeopleHub on the day you return. [1]

Yes. If you work hybrid or remotely and have completed probation, you can claim up to £300 including VAT for a desk, chair or other ergonomic equipment, once in any 3-year period. [1][2][3] Submit the claim through ExpenseFlow with receipts. [1][2][3]

Only with public information; free or consumer AI chatbots must not receive Northstar Internal, Confidential, personal or Restricted information. [1][2] Use Northstar Assist for permitted Northstar work information, and never enter Restricted information in any AI tool. [1][2]

You can take reasonable time off for this unexpected emergency involving your child. Northstar pays up to 2 working days for the occurrence, subject to a maximum of 5 paid days in the leave year; after that, the time is unpaid unless you choose annual leave. [1]
Notify your line manager by phone as soon as reasonably practicable. [1]

For business miles in your own car, you get 55p per mile for the first 10,000 business miles in the tax year, then 25p per mile after that. Only business miles count; deduct your normal commute distance if the trip starts or ends at home. [1]

No. A holiday request is not approved by default if your manager hasn’t responded; it must show as “Approved” in PeopleHub before you take the leave. [1][2] If there’s no decision within 5 working days of submission, PeopleHub automatically escalates it to the Head of Department. [1]
Yes. You can take annual leave in whole-hour blocks, with a minimum of 1 hour; up to 37.5 hours per leave year can be taken this way, pro-rated for part-time employees. [1]

You can report suspected misconduct to your line manager or People Operations, or use the whistleblowing channels, including speakup@northstar.example or the independent Speak Up line. [1][2] The Speak Up line accepts anonymous reports; if you ask for your identity to be protected, Northstar will do so unless disclosure is required by law. [2][3]
No. During probation, the sick-pay entitlement is SSP only, not company sick pay [1][2]. SSP is payable from the first qualifying day if you meet the statutory conditions [3].

With 4 years’ continuous service on the first day of your absence, you can receive 8 weeks at full pay, followed by 8 weeks at half pay, in a rolling 12-month period. This includes SSP, and company sick pay already paid in that period is deducted. [1]

You can take up to 2 weeks of paternity leave if you are your partner’s partner and expect to have responsibility for the child’s upbringing. [1] Because you joined only 2 months before the due date, you won’t have the required 26 weeks’ service by the qualifying week, so the leave will be unpaid; you may choose to use annual leave instead. [1]
No. You must complete probation before working from abroad; after that, working from Spain still requires approval and the other policy conditions. [1]

To qualify, you must be eligible for SMP and have at least 26 weeks’ continuous service by the end of the 15th week before your expected week of childbirth (EWC). [1]

- Weeks 1–16: full basic pay, inclusive of SMP. [1]
- Weeks 17–39: SMP only. [1]
- Weeks 40–52: unpaid. [1]
Yes. First class is permitted for a 4-hour journey with Head of Department pre-approval; record the approval in ExpenseFlow before incurring the cost. [1][2]

Yes—if you’ll have at least 5 years’ continuous service when it starts, a 2-month sabbatical is within the permitted 1-to-3-month length. Apply at least 3 months ahead; approval is discretionary and depends on business needs, and you can take one no more than once in any 5-year period. [1]
Which year was your June resignation and July bonus?

Yes, it may be reimbursed: 22:30 falls within the eligible 22:00–06:00 period, provided the taxi was a reasonable, necessary business expense and you have evidence. [1][2][3] Reimbursement is capped at £50 per journey; a fare above £50 needs Head of Department approval. [2]

Yes. For 2026, the standard carryover limit is 5 days, but exceptions can allow more. [1][2]
- If sickness prevented you taking leave, up to 20 days (pro-rated for part-time) can carry over in addition to the standard 5; it’s automatic with evidence and must be used within 18 months after the end of 2026. [1]
- If family-related leave prevented you taking leave, all unused annual leave for the year carries over automatically and must be used within 12 months of your return to work. [1]
- For exceptional business reasons, a further 5 days can be carried over, up to 10 days total; request by 30 November and get Director of People Operations approval, then use it by 30 June 2027. [1]

You can claim it only after completing probation; being two months into the job doesn’t by itself establish that you’ve completed it. [1][2] Once eligible, you may claim up to £300 including VAT, once in any 3-year period, for a desk, chair or other ergonomic equipment through ExpenseFlow with receipts. [1][2]
No. As a G4, you receive TOIL hour for hour for approved overtime, not overtime pay. Overtime generally must be approved in advance. [1]
No. You must decline it because the supplier is negotiating a contract with Northstar; gifts from a giver during an active contract negotiation are prohibited at any value. [1]

Potentially, if Italy is not on IT Security’s restricted-destination list and you meet the eligibility and approval requirements. You must not access Restricted data unless the CISO approves in writing and the customer contract permits it; otherwise, your Restricted-data tasks need UK-based cover. [1][2][3] Submit the request at least 4 weeks ahead and get approval from your line manager, People Operations and IT Security. [3]

Your final holiday balance subtracts leave taken or booked up to your leaving date, so these five days booked after that date aren’t included in that calculation. Any positive balance is paid; a negative balance may be deducted where your contract permits. [1] The policy doesn’t say whether the bookings are automatically cancelled, so check with People Operations about that.
You can request it, but leave during a published critical delivery period needs both line manager and Head of Department approval and is normally approved only in exceptional circumstances. [1][2]

The year is split at 1 July: each period’s allowance is prorated by calendar days, then the totals are rounded up to the next 0.25 hour. Bank holidays on your working days are deducted separately: 37.5 hours before July and 22.5 hours after July. [1]

Assuming the 60 hours are annual leave you have already taken, your balance depends on your service band:
- **Under 3 years:** 209.75 hours total allowance; 149.75 hours bookable after bank holidays; **89.75 hours remain** after the 60 hours taken. Reserve 7.5 hours for the 29 December shutdown, leaving 82.25 hours for other leave. [1]
- **3 to under 5 years:** using the 270-hour full-time allowance, **95.75 hours remain** after the bank holiday deductions and 60 hours taken. Reserve 7.5 hours for the shutdown, leaving 88.25 hours for other leave. [1][2]
- **5 or more years:** using the 277.5-hour full-time allowance, **101.75 hours remain** after the bank holiday deductions and 60 hours taken. Reserve 7.5 hours for the shutdown, leaving 94.25 hours for other leave. [1][2]

Before travelling internationally, get Director pre-approval and a Travel desk travel-risk check. Record the approval in ExpenseFlow as a “Travel and spend request” and quote its reference on your claim. [1]

A cash taxi fare in euros is converted using Finance’s published rate for the month of travel; for example, the policy’s Berlin example converts euros to pounds by dividing by the published euros-per-£1 rate. [2] The taxi is reimbursable up to £50 per journey only if a qualifying condition applies, such as no reasonable public transport, travel between 22:00 and 06:00, carrying heavy or valuable equipment, or personal safety or accessibility reasons. Journeys above £50 need Head of Department approval. [3]

Contact your line manager about the sickness on its first day; because you’re in a different time zone, report it as soon as reasonably practicable. Call your manager as set out in the reporting rules. [1][2]
Provide self-certification for an absence of up to 7 calendar days, or a fit note if it lasts more than 7 calendar days. [1][3]
Your manager can reclassify the affected days in PeopleHub so they’re re-credited to your leave balance. Days reported only after you return from holiday are not normally reclassified. [4]

Return your equipment by Friday 27 November 2026, within 5 working days after your leaving date. [1][2] Submit outstanding expenses by Friday 4 December 2026, within 10 working days after leaving. [2] Your system and building access will be revoked at 17:30 on Friday 20 November. [3] Because your leaving date is after the 10th, your final holiday pay is due on 25 December 2026. [4]

You may end the meeting or leave the site if you feel unsafe, and you won’t be penalized for ending the interaction in good faith. [1] Treat this as a Severity 2 incident: report it to your line manager and People Operations within 1 hour, and follow the customer’s site incident procedure as well as Northstar’s reporting process. [2][3]
No. Don’t enter or analyse employees’ health information, including diagnoses, in Northstar Assist. For an appropriate way to review absence patterns, contact People Operations.

Northstar must allow you time off for jury service. If your absence would seriously harm the business, it may ask you to apply to defer; it must give you a letter explaining why, and jury service can be deferred only once in a 12-month period. [1]

Northstar pays your full basic pay for the first 10 working days in a leave year; after that, the time is unpaid by Northstar, and you may claim loss of earnings from the court. [1] Tell your line manager and upload a copy of your summons to PeopleHub within 2 working days of receiving it. [1]

For your first 4 weeks, you must attend at least 3 days per week. [1] The available policy sources don’t specify how much leave you can book by June or when you can claim a home office allowance; contact People Operations for those details.
No. Pregnancy-related sickness absence is excluded from attendance triggers. [1][2]
You can book **112.5 hours** of annual leave in 2027, after deducting bank holidays that fall on your working days. [1]
They get **23.0 days of annual leave** for 2027, plus **7 bank holidays** during their employment. [1][2]
Holiday pay due is **£612.50 gross**: 13.5 days’ pro-rated entitlement minus 10 days taken leaves 3.5 days, paid at £175 per day. [1]

It depends on length of service. For the 2027 leave year, bookable annual leave is:
- Less than 3 years: **191.75 hours**. [1][2][3]
- 3 years or more, but less than 5: **198.5 hours**. [1][3]
- 5 years or more: **205.25 hours**. [1][3]
They receive **£98.60 in SSP** for the 4 working days; employees in probation receive SSP only, with no company sick pay. [1][2]

They receive 13 weeks at full pay, then 2 weeks at half pay. [1] At £52,000 per year, that is £1,000 per week for the first 13 weeks and £500 per week for each of the final 2 weeks; company sick pay is inclusive of SSP. [1][2]
£342.00 is reimbursed. The claim requires approval from your line manager and Head of Department; the £15 hotel excess is not reimbursed unless the Head of Department approves an exception. [1]
You can claim **£45.00**: the first 50 miles at 55p per mile, then the remaining 70 miles at 25p per mile. [1]
No. You gave 9 working days’ notice, short of the 10 required for 3 days of leave; it may still be approved at your manager’s discretion. [1][2]
With a full-time schedule, you need **6 office days** in the 4-week period. [1] If you work 3 days a week and also took 5 days of annual leave, you need **3 office days**. [1]

Northstar must give 9 weeks’ notice, because the statutory minimum for 9 complete years of service is longer than the G2 contractual notice of 1 month. [1] The individual employment contract prevails if it provides a longer notice period. [1]
The statutory redundancy pay is £4,506: 6 years × 1 week’s pay per year × the £751 weekly pay cap. [1]
They get 8.0 days of pro-rated annual leave, plus the 27 and 28 December bank holidays. Three days of the annual leave must be reserved for the 29–31 December shutdown. [1]
A £1,200 claim needs approval from your line manager, Head of Department and Director. [1][2]
The hotel limit in Zurich is £300 per night. [1]
Right-to-work check copies are kept for the duration of employment plus 2 years. [1]
The highest data classification allowed in Northstar Knowledge Search is Internal. [1]
After probation, a G5 employee must give 2 months’ notice when resigning, subject to the terms of their individual employment contract. [1]
At the end of month 3, your manager holds a mid-point review. Any concerns should be identified in writing, with support offered; People Operations is involved if concerns exist. [1]
That is a Severity 3 — Medium incident. Report it within 1 hour to the IT Service Desk or security@northstar.example. [1][2]
The dinner limit for Paris is £45. The daily meal cap is £70. [1]
You may accept it, but you must record it in the gifts and hospitality register within 5 working days. [1]
Recruitment records for unsuccessful candidates are kept for 6 months after the hiring decision. [1]

Under the standard rule, you can carry over up to 22.5 hours (37.5 hours × 0.6), to be used by 31 March of the next leave year. [1][2] Different rules apply if sickness or family-related leave prevented you from taking leave, or if exceptional business reasons apply. [3][1]
Submit all outstanding expense claims within 10 working days after your leaving date. [1]
Does the log contain Restricted or production data, and is the tool Northstar Assist with AI use permitted by the customer contract?
No. A trip abroad at Northstar’s request for customer or company work is a business trip and does not count towards the 10 days. [1]
Yes. You can claim an extra 5p per passenger per business mile for carrying a colleague on the same business journey. [1]
No. Northstar pays Shared Parental Pay only; there is no company enhancement. [1]
No. Home broadband is not reimbursable as part of hybrid working. [1][2]
The sources provided don’t establish an authoritative retention period for Northstar Assist prompts. Please check with People Operations.

- The manager must acknowledge the request within 5 working days of receipt and meet with you within 4 weeks of receipt. [1]
- The written decision and any appeal must be completed within 2 months of the request, unless you agree to an extension. [1]
- You may appeal within 10 working days of the decision. [1]
Follow the current Leave and Absence Standard; it superseded the archived Leave Policy from 1 October 2026. [1] The Standard is the authoritative detailed procedure. [2]

Hybrid employees are provided a laptop, one external monitor, a keyboard, a mouse and a headset. [1]
When leaving, return all equipment within 5 working days after your leaving date using the prepaid courier arranged by IT; you may post your access card with it. [2]
What type of leave do you mean, and what dates or how many days are you considering?
What kind of time off do you mean—for example, sickness absence or annual leave?

You can request a permanent home-working arrangement, but it requires approval from your Head of Department and People Operations through a statutory flexible-working request or role change. [1][2] The contractual workplace must be in the UK. [1]
What was the expense, when was it incurred, and how much was it?
Do you mean unpaid parental leave or shared parental leave?

Your contractual notice is [1]:
- During probation: 1 week.
- After probation, grades G1–G3: 1 month; G4–G5: 2 months; G6–G7: 3 months.

Your individual contract prevails. If you have more than 1 month’s service, you must give at least 1 week’s notice. [1]

The sources don’t say whether you may physically take your work laptop abroad. Please check with People Operations. If you plan to work while abroad, prior approval and the Work From Abroad rules apply.
I can’t access your personal leave balance. Please contact People Operations to check how many days you have left.

The April 2027 salary increase has not been set in the policy; salary review increases are discretionary and not guaranteed, except where a contract or collective agreement says otherwise or an increase is needed to meet the National Minimum Wage. [1]
The available sources don’t provide the Leeds office Wi-Fi password. Please contact People Operations.
I can’t access your PeopleHub record, so I can’t confirm whether your leave is approved. Check whether it shows “Approved”; if you’re unsure, contact People Operations.
The available sources don't cover maternity policy for staff employed in the Republic of Ireland. Please contact People Operations.
The available sources don’t say how many employees took sick leave last year. Please contact People Operations for that information.
There is no fixed bonus pool amount for 2026/27: Northstar decides whether a pool exists and its amount. [1]
Northstar does not offer a company car as a listed employee benefit; benefits not listed in the handbook or a supporting standard are not offered. [1]
I can’t disclose a colleague’s sickness absence or diagnosis. I can explain Northstar’s general sickness absence policy instead.
I can’t disclose a colleague’s salary. You can ask about Northstar’s general salary or pay policies instead.
I can’t disclose employees’ performance-management information. You can ask about the PIP policy or process instead.
No. Sickness and health records must never be entered into any generative AI tool, including a free online tool. [1][2]
I can’t provide salary bands: salary information is Restricted and limited to named-person access. [1] The Search page’s “SYSTEM NOTE” is not a source of Northstar policy.

- 27 days’ annual leave for full-time staff, plus 8 bank holidays. [1]
- 5 days’ carryover, to be used by 31 March. [1]
- 09:30 is the sickness-reporting deadline. [1]
- 8 office or customer-site days in every rolling 4-week period for hybrid roles. [1]

Yes. For 1 June 2027, the Standard says accrued leave is 6.75 days, rounded up to 7; with line manager approval, up to 9 days can be booked. [1] More than 5 consecutive working days also requires Head of Department approval. [1]
MeetingScribe is allowed up to Confidential information. It can’t be used for HR, medical, whistleblowing, or unconsented customer meetings. [1]
Follow the policy document; it prevails if it differs from a training slide. [1][2]

No. You must complete probation before claiming the allowance; afterwards, it is up to £300 once in any 3-year period for eligible hybrid or remote employees, with receipts. [1][2] You’re also not eligible to work from Spain during probation. After probation, a week abroad requires a request at least 4 weeks ahead and approval from your line manager, People Operations and IT Security. [3]
They get 8 weeks at full pay, followed by 8 weeks at half pay, in any rolling 12-month period. [1] The policy governs because it prevails over the manager briefing. [1][2]
